_comment: Mobile-only strings. Locales/*.json is overwritten wholesale by the mainline extractor, so these live here. Loc.Load overlays them.
_voiceComment: Hwang doesn't explain himself. Short sentences, no reasons given, exact counts. The point of this file is that a quest reads as somebody asking for something, not as a shopping list.
DQ_HWANG_BOLT_01_ACCEPT: Five bolts. Proper spec. Don't bring me what you scraped off the road.
DQ_HWANG_BOLT_01_COMPLETE: These'll do. Keep it up and the work keeps coming.
DQ_HWANG_BANDAGE_01_ACCEPT: Three bandages. Somebody's in a hurry. Don't ask why.
DQ_HWANG_AMMO_01_ACCEPT: Thirty rounds, 5.45. Reloads are fine, long as they don't blow up.
DQ_HWANG_AMMO_01_COMPLETE: Counted them. Thirty. You're good with numbers.
DQ_HWANG_RATION_01_ACCEPT: Food. Any kind. Just not spoiled.
DQ_HWANG_RATION_01_COMPLETE: This goes uptown. Your share's in cash.
DQ_HWANG_METAL_01_ACCEPT: Metal, whatever you've got. Four pieces. Nothing rusted through.
DQ_HWANG_METAL_01_COMPLETE: Weight's right. You'll get your price.
DQ_HWANG_MEDS_01_ACCEPT: I need medicine. Painkillers, anything — as long as it's still labeled.
DQ_HWANG_MEDS_01_COMPLETE: That's worth real money. I paid you proper.
DQ_HWANG_PCB_01_ACCEPT: Five boards. Nothing burnt. The legs have to be on.
DQ_HWANG_PCB_01_COMPLETE: Where did you find these. ...Never mind. Better I don't ask.
DQ_HWANG_RIFLE_01_ACCEPT: One rifle, sixty rounds. Somebody's going out. I don't know who.
DQ_HWANG_RIFLE_01_COMPLETE: Got it. ...If they come back, I'll have them buy you a drink.
_eventComment: Expedition event reports. The same event reads differently depending on who you sent - hence two lines. Written as radio reports: short, flat, factual.
EV_AMBUSH_PASS: Walked into an ambush. Pushed through. Burned some ammo.
EV_AMBUSH_FAIL: Ambush. Dropped the haul and got out.
EV_SURVIVOR_PASS: Brought a survivor back. Hwang says he'll handle it.
EV_SURVIVOR_FAIL: Saw a survivor. Couldn't carry them. ...Left them.
EV_LOCKED_CACHE_PASS: Got the locked cache open. It was full.
EV_LOCKED_CACHE_FAIL: Found a locked cache. Couldn't open it. Marked the spot.
EV_SCRAP_HAUL_PASS: Hauled an abandoned cart back whole.
EV_SCRAP_HAUL_FAIL: Found a cart. Too heavy - took what we could carry.
EV_TOLL_PASS: Crew blocking the road. They moved.
EV_TOLL_FAIL: Crew blocking the road. Paid the toll.
EV_MEDICAL_CACHE_PASS: Dug through a collapsed pharmacy. Found something usable.
EV_MEDICAL_CACHE_FAIL: The pharmacy had already been picked clean.
EV_RADIO_CONTACT_PASS: Picked up a transmission. Got coordinates - Hwang will pay well.
EV_RADIO_CONTACT_FAIL: Picked up a transmission. Just static. Too far out.
DQ_CHOI_BANDAGE_01_ACCEPT: Bring four bandages. Set aside any with wet packaging.
DQ_CHOI_BANDAGE_01_COMPLETE: Clean and dry. These will get us through tonight.
DQ_CHOI_FIRSTAID_01_ACCEPT: I need three first aid kits. Check that nothing is missing.
DQ_CHOI_FIRSTAID_01_COMPLETE: Everything is here. I will take these to the patients.
DQ_CHOI_TAPE_01_ACCEPT: Four rolls of tape and two bandages. We need to secure splints.
DQ_CHOI_TAPE_01_COMPLETE: These will hold when they move. Thank you.
DQ_CHOI_IFAK_01_ACCEPT: Three IFAKs, please. They are for the people heading out.
DQ_CHOI_IFAK_01_COMPLETE: I will give each of them one. I hope they return without needing them.
DQ_CHOI_PAINKILL_01_ACCEPT: Two packs of painkillers and three bandages. Too many people are hurting tonight.
DQ_CHOI_PAINKILL_01_COMPLETE: I will hand out the medicine first. Perhaps they can get some sleep.
DQ_CHOI_TOURNIQUET_01_ACCEPT: Two tourniquets and two first aid kits. We need to be ready for bleeding.
DQ_CHOI_TOURNIQUET_01_COMPLETE: We are ready now. Let us hope we do not need them.
DQ_CHOI_SURGERY_01_ACCEPT: Two Grizzly kits and two IFAKs. I am preparing for a major procedure.
DQ_CHOI_SURGERY_01_COMPLETE: Nothing is missing. I will take it from here.
DQ_KIM_WIRE_01_ACCEPT: Four bundles of wire. Check the copper, not just the insulation.
DQ_KIM_WIRE_01_COMPLETE: Continuity checks out. Enough to redo the wiring.
DQ_KIM_FAN_01_ACCEPT: Two cooling fans and two bundles of wire. No seized bearings.
DQ_KIM_FAN_01_COMPLETE: A little noise is fine. They spin, so they will move the heat.
DQ_KIM_PLUG_01_ACCEPT: Three spark plugs. Check the electrodes for wear first.
DQ_KIM_PLUG_01_COMPLETE: Just need to set the gaps. Good work.
DQ_KIM_PCB_01_ACCEPT: Four circuit boards. Pick ones with intact traces.
DQ_KIM_PCB_01_COMPLETE: Plenty of usable components. Worth taking these apart.
DQ_KIM_CPU_01_ACCEPT: Two processors and two boards. Tell me about bent pins before handing them over.
DQ_KIM_CPU_01_COMPLETE: Pins look good. I will handle powering them up.
DQ_KIM_PSU_01_ACCEPT: Two power supplies and three bundles of wire. Leave anything that smells burnt.
DQ_KIM_PSU_01_COMPLETE: These should restore power. Just the load test left.
DQ_KIM_MOTOR_01_ACCEPT: Two motors and three boards. Check for bent shafts too.
DQ_KIM_MOTOR_01_COMPLETE: Smooth rotation. Now I can fit the controller.
